component.name: -board
component.summary: Live dashboard and desktop widget for your home server

description.p: -board shows whether your home server is up, its CPU, RAM, storage and network (from Glances), and buttons for your services with up / down dots. Group services into stacks, switch between several servers, and reboot or shut down ZimaOS, Proxmox VE, TrueNAS, Unraid, Synology DSM, OpenMediaVault and Linux servers.
Classic and Liquid Glass styles, seven themes, accent colours, and small / medium / large desktop widgets.
